column1: # South Park: The Fractured But Whole on Android (keys in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md "Game profiles on Android")
# Tested 2026-11-10 on the Odin 2 Portal (Snapdragon 8 Gen 2, Adreno 740) with a Turnip Vulkan driver (porter --vulkan-driver, or its vulkan_driver setting):
# the opening hours (title, character creation, the town, the house, Kupa Keep, fights, saving and loading) at a steady 30 fps, as on the Switch, with sound.
# Use Turnip. On Qualcomm's own driver (512.863) the views through windows showed one-frame blocks and specks (an offscreen view sampled in the same frame),
# and the game stalled for about 0.4 s every few seconds until, after about 5 minutes, it froze; Turnip has neither. The host matches Turnip's UBWC hint to
# Qualcomm's driver on the Adreno 740 (gfx_vk_core.c tu_ubwc_hint), without which Android's own drawing over the game flickers.
# The interface quads come from a buffer texture whose handle sits in the game's own constant buffer; the core binds such buffers as rows of a 2D image
# (vk_tbuf_rows_view), without which every screen stayed black. The save pictures are a CopyTextureToTexture into a linear texture that the CPU reads:
# the core writes such copies back to their storage (gfx_vk_exec.c copy_t2t).
# The main menu's Nintendo eShop and Ubisoft Club entries are dropped (sdf_edits.tsv): they lead to services the port cannot reach.
